passage.label: An-Nisa — If decreed kill selves or leave homes few would do it; if did what instructed better and firmer; great reward and straight path; whoever obeys Allah and Messenger with prophets, truthful, martyrs, righteous — excellent companions; bounty from Allah sufficient Knower; take precaution go forth in companies or together; laggards claim divine favor when disaster strikes others, wish presence when bounty comes; sell worldly life for hereafter fight in Allah's way killed or victorious great reward; why not fight for oppressed men women children praying for deliverance from oppressive city and protector/helper; believers fight in Allah's way disbelievers in taghut's way fight allies of shaytan whose plot is weak; those told restrain hands establish prayer give zakah now fear people when fighting prescribed; say enjoyment of world little hereafter better for god-fearing not wronged even thread; death overtakes everywhere even fortified towers; attribute good to Allah evil to Prophet; say all from Allah; what is wrong with people scarcely understanding; good from Allah evil from yourself; sent as messenger to mankind sufficient Witness; obeying Messenger = obeying Allah; whoever turns away not sent as guardian; say peace but plan differently at night; Allah records turn away trust Allah sufficient Disposer; reflect upon Quran no contradiction if from other than Allah; spread news of security or fear; if referred to Messenger and authorities those extracting would know; but for Allah's favor and mercy would follow shaytan except few; fight in Allah's way responsible only for yourself encourage believers perhaps Allah restrains disbelievers' might stronger in punishment; good intercession share of it evil intercession burden of it Watcher over all; greet with better or return it Accountant of all

arabicExcerpts.text: وَلَوۡ أَنَّا كَتَبۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَنِ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱخۡرُجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِكُم مَّا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ فَعَلُواْ مَا يُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ تَثۡبِيتٗا
وَإِذٗا لَّأٓتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّن لَّدُنَّآ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَۚ وَحَسُنَ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ رَفِيقٗا
ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ عَلِيمٗا
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ خُذُواْ حِذۡرَكُمۡ فَٱنفِرُواْ ثُبَاتٍ أَوِ ٱنفِرُواْ جَمِيعٗا
وَإِنَّ مِنكُمۡ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنۡ أَصَٰبَتۡكُم مُّصِيبَةٞ قَالَ قَدۡ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيَّ إِذۡ لَمۡ أَكُن مَّعَهُمۡ شَهِيدٗا
وَلَئِنۡ أَصَٰبَكُمۡ فَضۡلٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَيَقُولَنَّ كَأَن لَّمۡ تَكُنۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ مَوَدَّةٞ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ مَعَهُمۡ فَأَفُوزَ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمٗا
۞فَلۡيُقَٰتِلۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشۡرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ وَمَن يُقَٰتِلۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيُقۡتَلۡ أَوۡ يَغۡلِبۡ فَسَوۡفَ نُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا

وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّٗا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا

mainSubject.label: Hypothetical decree to kill selves or leave homes: few would comply; compliance would be better and firmer for conviction leading to great reward and straight path; obedience to Allah and Messenger places one with prophets, truthful affirmers (siddeeqeen), martyrs (shuhada'), and righteous (saliheen) as excellent companions; divine bounty and sufficient knowledge; military precautions: go forth in detachments or all together; psychology of laggards: claim divine favor when disaster strikes believers, wish they were present when bounty comes as if no affection existed; selling worldly life for hereafter through fighting in Allah's way whether killed or victorious earning great reward; motivation to fight for oppressed men, women, children crying for deliverance from oppressive city and requesting protector and helper from Allah; believers fight in Allah's way, disbelievers in taghut's way — fight allies of shaytan whose plot is ever weak; those previously told to restrain hands, establish prayer, give zakah now fear people as much as or more than fearing Allah when fighting prescribed; response: worldly enjoyment is little, hereafter better for god-fearing, no injustice even as thread; inevitability of death even in fortified towers; attributing good to Allah and evil to Prophet — correction: all is from Allah; what is wrong with people barely understanding; refined: good from Allah, evil from yourself; Prophet sent to mankind, Allah sufficient Witness; obeying Messenger equals obeying Allah; turning away — Prophet not sent as guardian; hypocrites say peace but plan differently at night; Allah records their plotting — turn away and trust Allah as sufficient Disposer; reflection on Quran reveals no contradiction proving divine origin; spreading rumors of security or fear instead of referring to Messenger and authorities; but for Allah's favor and mercy most would follow shaytan except few; fight in Allah's way responsible only for yourself, encourage believers, perhaps Allah will restrain disbelievers' might — Allah stronger in might and punishment; intercession: good intercession earns share, evil earns burden, Allah Watcher over all; greeting etiquette: respond with better or equal, Allah Accountant of all

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: take your precaution and go forth in detachments or go forth all together.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: let those who sell the life of this world for the Hereafter fight in the cause of Allah.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّٗا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: why should you not fight in the cause of Allah and for the oppressed men, women, and children seeking deliverance.

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 8/8. Note: task instructions listed 4:66-75 as passage 8 but described content extending to 4:86+. The actual corpus dump covers 4:36-75 (40 verses), so passage 8 covers 4:66-75 only. Content beyond 4:75 (fighting details, intercession, greeting) falls outside this corpus range. This passage focuses on: hypothetical obedience test, four ranks of favored ones, military mobilization, laggard psychology, fighting for the oppressed. The mustad'afeen (oppressed) supplication in 4:75 provides emotional climax connecting qital to liberation theology.
